minimum_model: balanced differential launch plus local 2x2 even-odd branch
physical_mechanism: Suppress common-mode launch error and directly reshape adjacent active modes
advantages: Targets the observed active-modal failure; preserves one local stage and explicit reference planes
risks: Requires a realizable balun or differential source and careful symmetry
promotion_gate: Three-frequency passive RL >=12 dB; representative active RL >=11 dB; efficiency >=95%; repeat Delta S <=0.05

physical_mechanism: Separate radiator and feed currents while adding coupling-tuned resonance
advantages: Better feed-radiator isolation and useful bandwidth control
risks: More layers and slot tolerance; higher CAD and manufacturing complexity
promotion_gate: Same three-frequency physical gates with transducer efficiency reported

physical_mechanism: Use two nearby physical resonances to broaden the matched active-mode band
risks: Resonance splitting may vary with array environment
promotion_gate: Same three-frequency physical gates plus tolerance smoke

minimum_model: feed-point local modal loading without extra network stage
physical_mechanism: Move one manufacturable even-odd correction element into the feed neighborhood
advantages: Smallest topology change after a balanced launch is available
risks: May not provide enough bandwidth or modal authority
promotion_gate: Stop immediately if 2x2 representative active RL remains below 11 dB
